driven by custom engineering (~85%) and limited, non-structured service activity.
The company aims to evolve into a  scalable, product-driven and service-enabled business, targeting
~€3.5M annual revenue within 3 years.
This transformation is based on three pillars: - Standardized product sales (core growth engine) - Controlled
custom projects (strategic role) - Scalable service & maintenance business (recurring revenue engine)
Additionally, the company will leverage its strong engineering DNA and flexibility to position itself as a high-
ROI industrial partner in the corrugated packaging sector.
